description: Main source code for configuring and handling the Analog Comparator (ACMP) sensor on a specific hardware platform using Zephyr RTOS. It sets up attributes, triggers, and handlers for ACMP input monitoring.

methods.name: acmp_input_handler
methods.description: Handles ACMP input threshold crossing events, printing whether input is above or below threshold.

methods.name: acmp_trigger_handler
methods.description: Callback for ACMP trigger events, calls acmp_input_handler based on trigger type.
